# ADR-NNNN: <Short decision, in the imperative ("Use X for Y")>

- **Status:** Proposed | Accepted | Superseded by [ADR-XXXX](./XXXX-slug.md) | Deprecated
- **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
- **Deciders:** <names or roles>
- **Scope:** mobile | web | shared | db | infra | cross-cutting
- **Related:** <issues, PRs, other ADRs>

## Context

What problem or force made a decision necessary? Describe the facts, constraints and options known at the time. Keep it neutral.

## Decision

What we will do, stated plainly. "We will…"

## Options considered

| Option | Pros | Cons |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A (chosen) | | |
| B | | |

## Consequences

- **Good:** what gets easier.
- **Bad / trade-offs:** what gets harder, what we now have to maintain.
- **Follow-ups:** issues to open, docs to update (link them).
